scripts.init: cd web_client && npm install && cd .. && cd wiim_server && npm install && cd ..
scripts.ui:docker:
docker compose up -d --build && echo '
Frontend running at http://localhost:3000'
scripts.serve: rm -rf ./wiim_server/public && cp -R ./web_client/dist ./wiim_server/public && cd wiim_server && npm run serve
scripts.serve:ui: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.dev: echo 'Start backend: npm run server:dev (in one terminal)' && echo 'Start frontend: npm run ui:dev OR npm run ui:docker (in another terminal)'
